result: MedCPT underperforms frozen SHIFT-MAP on all three primary ranking metrics for all seeds; preserve as a negative confirmatory result.

failure_categories.A_top1_regressions: All seeds have more baseline-correct-to-model-incorrect transitions than recoveries.
failure_categories.B_top1_recoveries: Recoveries do not offset top-1 regressions for any seed.
failure_categories.C_ordering_perturbation: Every source ordering changes; pairwise concordance is approximately 0.325.
failure_categories.D_structural_invariance: Hit@100 and Top-100 candidate membership remain invariant.
failure_categories.E_primary_metric_failure: All 95% bootstrap CIs for Hit@1, MRR, and NDCG@10 deltas are strictly below zero.

next_stage: Do not promote MedCPT as a replacement for SHIFT-MAP; stop R3 and require a separately preregistered hierarchy-aware reranker design before Step 9.
